name: Planet market activity is taxable
description: Verifies that a successful planet.market.sell command durably records one taxable market activity row.

tests.name: Setup: Admin
Setup: Tax activity seller
Save Exchange liquidity configuration
Fund Exchange clearing liquidity for the sale scenario
Remove prior isolated planet goods

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated planet stock

data.sql: DELETE FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated planet citadels

data.sql: DELETE FROM citadels WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated planet tax policies and assessments

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_tax_policies WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated planet assessments

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_tax_assessments WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated taxable activity

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test');

tests.name: Remove prior isolated test planet

data.sql: DELETE FROM planets WHERE name = 'V2 taxable activity test';

tests.name: Grant genesis device for planet creation

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET genesis = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'taxable_activity_seller');

tests.name: Create isolated market activity planet
Seed planet ORE stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('planet', @{test_planet_id}, 'ORE', 100) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = EXCLUDED.quantity;

tests.name: Seed citadel for market access

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, treasury, owner_id) VALUES (@{test_planet_id}, 1, 500, @{taxable_activity_seller_player_id}) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level = 1, owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Update planet citadel level

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET citadel_level = 1 WHERE planet_id = @{test_planet_id};

tests.name: Sell planet ORE through the client API
Verify one durable taxable activity row was recorded

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id = @{test_planet_id} AND activity_type = 'market_trade' AND commodity_code = 'ORE' AND quantity = 10 AND idempotency_key LIKE 'planet-trade:sell:%';

tests.name: Verify planetary-to-Exchange inventory conservation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{test_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{test_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE' AND quantity=10);

tests.name: Choose a real ORE-buying port for Exchange delivery

data.sql: SELECT p.port_id FROM ports p JOIN port_trade pt ON pt.port_id = p.port_id WHERE pt.commodity = 'ORE' AND pt.mode = 'buy' ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Isolate port demand and clear prior ORE inventory

data.sql: UPDATE commodity_orders SET status = 'cancelled', cancellation_reason = 'isolated Exchange delivery fixture' WHERE actor_type = 'port' AND actor_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND commodity_id = (SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') AND side = 'buy' AND status = 'open';

tests.name: Reset ORE inventory at selected port

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity) VALUES ('port', @{exchange_test_port_id}, 'ORE', 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 0;

tests.name: Fund port buyer for deterministic full Exchange fill

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = 50000 WHERE owner_type = 'port' AND owner_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE;

tests.name: Save buyer and Exchange clearing balances before purchase

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type = 'port' AND owner_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE), (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type = 'system' AND owner_id = 70000001 AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE);

tests.name: Place isolated port demand for the ring-fenced ORE

data.sql: INSERT INTO commodity_orders (actor_type, actor_id, location_type, location_id, commodity_id, side, quantity, filled_quantity, price, status, ts, expires_at) SELECT 'port', @{exchange_test_port_id}, 'port', @{exchange_test_port_id}, commodities_id, 'buy', 10, 0, 1000000, 'open', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 hour' FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE';

tests.name: Save isolated port demand order ID

data.sql: SELECT MAX(commodity_orders_id) FROM commodity_orders WHERE actor_type = 'port' AND actor_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND commodity_id = (SELECT commodities_id FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') AND side = 'buy' AND status = 'open';

tests.name: Make Exchange settlement due for port purchase

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_market_settlement';

tests.name: Wait for Exchange-to-port settlement
Verify Exchange-to-port commodity and credit conservation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id = @{test_planet_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'exchange' AND entity_id = 1 AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'port' AND entity_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('open','filled') AND filled_quantity = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM commodity_orders WHERE commodity_orders_id = @{exchange_port_order_id}), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commodity_trades ct JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.bank_transactions_id = ct.settlement_tx_buy JOIN bank_transactions s ON s.bank_transactions_id = ct.settlement_tx_sell WHERE ct.buyer_actor_type = 'port' AND ct.buyer_actor_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND ct.seller_actor_type = 'exchange' AND ct.seller_location_type = 'exchange' AND ct.seller_location_id = 1 AND ct.quantity = 10 AND b.direction = 'DEBIT' AND s.direction = 'CREDIT' AND b.amount = s.amount), (SELECT CASE WHEN balance = @{exchange_port_balance_before} - (SELECT base_price * 10 FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type = 'port' AND owner_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE), (SELECT CASE WHEN balance = @{exchange_balance_before_port_purchase} + (SELECT base_price * 10 FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type = 'system' AND owner_id = 70000001 AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE);

tests.name: Retry settlement and verify Exchange sale is not duplicated

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = 'daily_market_settlement';

tests.name: Wait for idempotent Exchange settlement retry
Verify retry did not duplicate stock, credits, or trade receipt

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'planet' AND entity_id = @{test_planet_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'exchange' AND entity_id = 1 AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type = 'port' AND entity_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND commodity_code = 'ORE'), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commodity_trades WHERE buyer_actor_type = 'port' AND buyer_actor_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND seller_actor_type = 'exchange' AND seller_location_id = 1 AND quantity = 10), (SELECT CASE WHEN balance = @{exchange_port_balance_before} - (SELECT base_price * 10 FROM commodities WHERE code = 'ORE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type = 'port' AND owner_id = @{exchange_test_port_id} AND currency = 'CRD' AND is_active = TRUE);

tests.name: Restore Exchange liquidity configuration
